title: Jamaican Spicy Paneer Crumble
description: A delicious Indian-inspired dish featuring a spicy Jamaican-inspired crumble topping over a bed of creamy paneer.
instructions: Cut the paneer into small cubes.
In a pan, heat some oil and sauté the onion until softened.
Add the garam masala, cumin, and salt, and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the paneer cubes and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the paneer mixture to a baking dish.
In a bowl, mix the flour, spicy Jamaican seasoning, and crumbly cheese.
Add the mixture to the baking dish, spreading evenly.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
